pages.caption: The King exclaimed, 'Good heavens! what do you say? I will watch myself to-night by
pages.description: [close-up portrait of King decides to watch himself]

pages.caption: the child's bed.'
pages.description: [medium shot of King decides to watch himself]

pages.caption: When the evening came he went to the nursery, and at midnight the Queen appeared
pages.description: [close-up portrait of King waits for ghost queen]

pages.caption: and said:
pages.description: [dramatic low angle of King waits for ghost]

pages.caption: 'Is my child well? Is my Roe well?
pages.description: [medium shot of Queen repeats rhyme]

pages.caption: I'll come back once and then farewell.'
pages.description: [close-up portrait of Queen promises final visit]

pages.caption: And she nursed and petted the child as usual before she disappeared.
pages.description: [medium shot of Queen nurses baby before vanishing]

pages.caption: The King dared not trust himself to speak to her, but the following night he
pages.description: [medium shot of King watches again]

pages.caption: kept watch again.
pages.description: [dramatic low angle of King watches again]

pages.caption: That night when the Queen came she said:
pages.description: [wide establishing shot of Queen appears for last]

pages.caption: 'Is my child well? Is my Roe well?
pages.description: [medium shot of Queen's final farewell rhyme]

pages.caption: I've come this once, and now farewell.'
pages.description: [medium shot of Queen declares final departure]

pages.caption: Then the King could restrain himself no longer, but sprang to her side and cried,
pages.description: [close-up portrait of King recognizes his wife]

pages.caption: 'You can be no one but my dear wife!'
pages.description: [dramatic low angle of King recognizes his wife]

pages.caption: 'Yes,' said she, 'I am your dear wife!' and in the same moment she was
pages.description: [wide establishing shot of Queen restored to life]

pages.caption: restored to life, and was as fresh and well and rosy as ever.
pages.description: [close-up portrait of Queen restored to life]

pages.caption: Then she told the King all the cruel things the wicked witch and her daughter
pages.description: [close-up portrait of Queen reveals witch's crimes]

pages.caption: had done.
pages.description: [medium shot of Queen reveals witch's crimes]

pages.caption: The King had them both arrested at once and brought to trial, and they were
pages.description: [wide establishing shot of King arrests witch]

pages.caption: condemned to death.
pages.description: [dramatic low angle of King arrests witch]

pages.caption: The daughter was led into the forest, where the wild beasts tore her to pieces,
pages.description: [medium shot of Ugly daughter torn by beasts]

pages.caption: and the old witch was burnt at the stake.
pages.description: [close-up portrait of Ugly daughter torn by beasts]

pages.caption: As soon as she was reduced to ashes the spell was taken off the little
pages.description: [close-up portrait of Roe restored to human form]

pages.caption: Roe,
pages.description: [medium shot of Roe restored to human form]

pages.caption: and he was restored to his natural shape once more, and so brother and sister
pages.description: [high angle view of Roe restored to human]

pages.caption: lived happily ever after.
pages.description: [dramatic low angle of Roe restored to human]
